headline: Kylym Bank expands its international correspondent network
summary: Kylym Bank, an Open Joint-Stock Company in Kyrgyzstan, has signed an agreement as part of a strategy to expand its correspondent banking network internationally.
why: Correspondent banking relationships let domestic banks process cross-border payments and currency transactions through foreign partner banks.
original_headline: Kylym Bank расширяет международную корреспондентскую сеть
